function: p. 4: Convolutional model selects the optimal far-field wide codeword (angle region) from received signal strengths, stage 1 of near-field beam training; stage 2 is non-learned beam sweeping.
system: pp. 2, 5: Uplink mmWave XL-MIMO, BS with 225x21=4725-antenna UPA, single-antenna user, f = 30 GHz, three scatters, near-field spherical-wave model; no RIS.
method: pp. 4-5: Supervised convolutional classifier (batch norm, two conv sub-modules, pooling, FC, softmax) trained on optimal-codeword labels; batch 64, 80 epochs, learning rate 2e-5.
data_channel: pp. 2, 5: Own near-field spherical-wave channel model, three paths; 25000-sample simulated dataset; no 3GPP model, public dataset, or measurements.
test_conditions: p. 5: 25000 samples split 80/10/10 into train, validation, test; accuracy and gain swept over SNR 0 to 20 dB; training SNR not stated; no unseen scenario.
baselines: p. 5: Beam sweeping; ideal codeword; codewords of [15] and BMW-SS [7] under the proposed protocol (non-learned); learned scheme of [5] with HCD-A and BMW-SS.
metrics: p. 5: Accuracy of optimal-codeword prediction; normalized beam gain versus transmit SNR; number of beam tests (360 versus 14175 for beam sweeping, p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "we are forced to take the spherical wavefront assumption into account". Own near-field model with random path gains (g1 ~ CN(0,1), others CN(0,0.01)); no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 5: "the validation set and the test set each account for 10%". Held-out part of the same simulated data; no test in another scenario, frequency, array size, or codebook is stated.
q3_support: p. 5: "We also compared the proposed training protocol with the method proposed in [5]" (earlier learned beam training) and "very close to the performance of the ideal codeword and beam sweeping" (non-learned), on accuracy and normalized beam gain.
q4_support: p. 5: "without any additional computational complexity" is qualitative, and the O(.) order given there is for the baseline of [15]. Only beam-test counts (p. 4) are reported, which is signaling overhead; no FLOPs, parameters, or runtime for the learned model.
q5_support: p. 5: "The dataset size is 25000". Self-generated simulation data; no link or DOI to code or data, and no public dataset or measured data.
notes: Included, area 3: learned near-field beam training, a beam selection function evaluated by codeword accuracy and normalized beam gain, not direction-of-arrival estimation alone. Only the stage-1 convolutional model is learned (p. 4); the hierarchical codebook HCD-A is a closed-form design and stage 2 is beam sweeping. The Fig. 5 legend cites [13] for the codeword baseline while the text cites [15] (p. 5).
